purpose: Teach: 北九州/日光/アフガン/モロッコ/ナポレオン/富士通/早稲田大学/京都大学

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが北九州の工場見学に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to take you on a factory tour in Kitakyushu.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle opening. Sharing good news without overselling it. Slight lift at the end—inviting his excitement, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと日光の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at the Nikko picture book together.
lines.style: Bright, quick energy. Child's pride in the shared moment—he wants her to know he had this time with Dad. Open vowels, no breathiness. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアフガン難民支援の話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was telling me about his Afghan refugee support work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly impressed tone. Observing something she's noticed about him. Steady pacing. Quiet respect woven through—she's sharing something she found meaningful about his character.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとモロッコ料理屋さん行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to a Moroccan restaurant.
lines.style: Bright, eager-to-share. Child's delight in the grown-up experience. Unguarded excitement. Quick pace, open mouth on the vowels. He's telling her something that felt special.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがナポレオンのドキュメンタリーを観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was watching a documentary about Napoleon.
lines.style: Observational, warm undertone. She's noticing the things he does, the details that compose him. Even-paced. Slight pause before the topic—letting it land as a small piece of him she's witnessing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの富士通のPC借りたよ
lines.en: Mom, I borrowed Dad's Fujitsu laptop.
lines.style: Quick, matter-of-fact report. Child's casual ownership of the small access he was granted. No hesitation—he's stating a fact that means he was trusted. Light, unconcerned delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが早稲田大学のOB会に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad went to his Waseda alumni gathering.
lines.style: Even, informative tone. She's reporting what she knows about his life. No judgment, no special emphasis—just part of the picture of who he is. Steady pace, unrushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと京都大学の見学に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to tour Kyoto University.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied close. Child's contentment in the memory. Slower than his other moments—savoring it. Soft, genuine smile audible in the voice. He's proud of the outing and of sharing it.
